title: Let's Learn English Lesson 35
subtitle: Let's Make Dinner!
attribution: Source: VOA Learning English – Let's Learn English Level 1, Lesson 35: Let's Make Dinner! (learningenglish.voanews.com). Public domain. This unofficial study helper is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi there! Washington, D.C. has many fun places to eat. But, sometimes it's more fun to cook. In fact, tonight Marsha and I are cooking for friends. Well, she is cooking. I am doing the shopping.
dialogue.zh: 嗨！华盛顿特区有很多好玩的吃饭地方。不过，有时做饭更有趣。其实，今晚玛莎和我要给朋友做饭。嗯，她做饭。我负责买菜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: It's Marsha. Hi, Marsha.
dialogue.zh: 是玛莎。嗨，玛莎。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Hi, Anna. Do you have the shopping list?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，安娜。你有购物清单吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes, I told you: I have the shopping list. Can you hear it?
dialogue.zh: 有，我告诉过你：我有购物清单。你能听见吗？

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Okay, good. I hear the list. Anna, please buy all the ingredients on the list.
dialogue.zh: 好，很好。我听见清单了。安娜，请把清单上的材料都买齐。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes, Marsha, I will.
dialogue.zh: 好的，玛莎，我会的。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: And do not spend too much time shopping.
dialogue.zh: 还有，买东西别花太长时间。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No, Marsha, I won't. See you later.
dialogue.zh: 不会的，玛莎。再见。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sometimes, Marsha worries too much. I love shopping! And, I did not spend too much money. Oh, no! But I did spend too much time! I have to return home now!
dialogue.zh: 有时候，玛莎担心太多。我爱购物！而且，我没有花太多钱。哦，不！可我花了太多时间！我现在得回家了！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Anna, what took you so long? Our guests will be here soon!
dialogue.zh: 安娜，你怎么去了这么久？客人马上就到！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Don't worry, Marsha. I bought everything on the list.
dialogue.zh: 别担心，玛莎。清单上的东西我都买了。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Let me see. You bought a bunch of bananas, a box of pancake mix, a bag of coffee … Anna, this is all wrong!
dialogue.zh: 我看看。你买了一串香蕉、一盒煎饼粉、一袋咖啡……安娜，这些全错了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What do you mean wrong? I bought a jar of peanut butter and a loaf of bread … no, wait … two loaves of bread.
dialogue.zh: 什么叫错了？我买了一罐花生酱和一条面包……不，等一下……两条面包。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Anna, these are the wrong ingredients!
dialogue.zh: 安娜，这些材料是错的！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: These ingredients are all on the list! I took this list from the counter.
dialogue.zh: 这些材料都在清单上！我是从台面上拿的这张清单。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Anna, this is the shopping list for breakfast. I said, take the shopping list - on the refrigerator - for dinner!
dialogue.zh: 安娜，这是早餐购物清单。我说的是，拿冰箱上那张——晚餐的——购物清单！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Marsha, there was no shopping list - on the refrigerator - for dinner!
dialogue.zh: 玛莎，冰箱上没有晚餐购物清单！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Oh no! It's on the floor!!
dialogue.zh: 哦不！它在地板上！！

dialogue.speaker: Anna and Marsha
dialogue.en: Ahh!!! Ahh!!!

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: What are we going to do?
dialogue.zh: 我们怎么办？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: When do our guests arrive?
dialogue.zh: 客人什么时候到？

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: They arrive in 30 minutes!
dialogue.zh: 他们 30 分钟后到！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I can fix this. Do you trust me?
dialogue.zh: 我能搞定。你相信我吗？

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Do I have to?
dialogue.zh: 必须信吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes.
dialogue.zh: 是的。

quiz.prompt: Which list did Anna shop from?
